title: Design Engineering Officer
content_text: Mildura Rural City Council, Design Engineering Officer, Job Number R2799, full time, Band 5 commencing at $80,057.64 plus super. Engineering Development & Delivery Branch: investigate, design and estimate road, drainage and other capital works projects using AutoCAD and Civil 3D, collaborating with internal teams, authorities and community stakeholders. Requirements: Degree or Diploma in Civil / Mechanical / Structural Engineering with little experience, or no formal qualifications but relevant road and drainage design skills; demonstrated working knowledge of the design of road and drainage works; demonstrated working knowledge of AutoCAD and Civil 3D, Word and Excel; ability to investigate and problem solve civil engineering issues; liaise with internal and external stakeholders; current driver's licence; police check or ability to obtain before commencement. Right to work in Australia required; Working with Children Check may be required; pre-employment medical may be required. Applications must include a completed Job Application Form, a resume and a covering letter addressing the key selection criteria. Position Description and Application Form at www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Jobs; HR (03) 5018 8197. Applications close 4pm Thursday 15 October 2026. Read 10 Oct 2026 AEDT.
apply_instructions: Apply through Mildura Rural City Council's jobs page (www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Jobs, job R2799, also via careersatcouncil.com.au Apply for this role) with the completed Job Application Form, resume and a covering letter addressing the key selection criteria, before 4pm Thursday 15 October 2026.
